focus: Ballerina pose ribbon and twirl input

route_status.proven_scope: The existing probe constructed OperaBalletSurface directly at 854x660 and exercised all three supported modes through their internal press/drag/release methods. It did not enter the Opera House or prove the child-visible Ballerina route.
route_gaps: child comprehension, enjoyment, and session length

source_constants.scripts/opera_ballet_surface.gd:31: strong assist after 10 seconds of playable no-progress time

estimates: A successful in-game route that completes all acts may take at least the demos plus deliberate input; no total duration is inferable from the internal probe.
The helper's 2.227-second wall time is tool runtime and is not gameplay duration.

tactile.target_size: Probe verifies pose portraits are at least 180x180 at its 854x660 test surface; ribbon resume target is 128x128 base pixels, corridor 116 pixels, twirl ring 116 pixels wide and handle diameter 112 pixels. DL-UI-03's 110x110 threshold is met in these assertions, but phone projection and finger occlusion are untested.
tactile.press_response: Probe confirms a matching portrait banks one round; invalid portrait yields no payout and replays its demo. Ribbon/twirl wrong paths do not pay; positive progress emits gesture feedback. Rendered response latency is not measured.
tactile.drag_hold_release: Ribbon accepts progress along the S curve and keeps monotonic partial progress after release; twirl accepts incremental movement around the ring and preserves partial progress after release. No long press is required.
tactile.ownership: The surface's internal held state gates drags and is cleared on release. This probe directly calls private handlers and cannot establish real pointer ownership, competing fingers, pause/focus cancellation, or hardware sampling.
tactile.cancellation: Lifting mid-ribbon or mid-twirl preserves accepted progress. Probe also checks straight-chord/diameter attempts do not bypass the required path. No real focus-loss cancellation was exercised.

play_appeal.hypothesis: The three-act switch from pose matching to tracing a glowing current to orbiting a shell gives a young player distinct hand actions and visible authorship. The orbit's Roshan pose cues may make the final gesture feel like a performance rather than filling a meter. Repeating the recital could be satisfying if the child notices the held pose phrase and changing direction freedom.
play_appeal.appeal_test: On the intended phone, observe whether the child chooses to repeat a favorite act or asks to perform the recital again without adult prompting; note spontaneous smiles/vocalizations and whether they describe or imitate Roshan's poses. Do not infer appeal from probe completion.

observations.title: Pose phrase varies pose and answer position
evidence: scripts/opera_ballet_surface.gd:19-21 defines target frames [3,2,1] and changing answer sets.
scripts/probe_opera_gesture_quality.gd:255-264 verifies the low-open-crown phrase and correct portrait positions right, center, then left; runtime receipt reports ALL OK (274 checks).
observations.reproduction: In the probe, allow each pose demo to finish, tap the matching portrait for three rounds, and inspect the target frame/answer x positions.
observations.child_impact: Distinct held poses and changing answer location can reward watching and intentional choice instead of repeated tapping.
observations.proposed_repair: No repair indicated by this evidence; confirm child can distinguish the poses on device.
observations.acceptance_test: At phone size, a child watches each held pose and selects the matching portrait on all three rounds without reading or adult instruction; wrong taps retain the current round.

observations.title: Tracing tolerates lifting and resuming
evidence: scripts/opera_ballet_surface.gd:433-468 accepts forward samples near the painted curve and banks monotonic progress.
scripts/probe_opera_gesture_quality.gd:293-314 traces in 0.075-progress increments, lifts near halfway, restarts the demo, resumes, and verifies completion.
observations.reproduction: Start at the resume pearl, trace to halfway, release, allow the demo to run, press the new resume pearl, and continue along the same S curve.
observations.child_impact: A brief finger slip does not erase already completed work, supporting forgiving one-finger play.
observations.proposed_repair: No repair indicated by the internal probe; test the real surface with a small finger and coarse movement on the target device.
observations.acceptance_test: On the exact phone build, lift/re-touch at early, middle, and late curve points; progress remains visible and resumes without jumping or requiring a precise continuous stroke.

observations.title: Twirl requires a coherent orbit and allows either direction
evidence: scripts/opera_ballet_surface.gd:494-544 requires ring contact, bounded adjacent angular steps, and a consistent direction before banking progress.
scripts/probe_opera_gesture_quality.gd:327-377 verifies center/diameter gestures pay nothing, a half-turn resumes, and clockwise and counter-clockwise full turns complete.
observations.reproduction: Press the ring handle, drag adjacent sectors around half the ring, release, replay, then continue; separately start a fresh twirl in the other direction.
observations.child_impact: A child can choose a direction and recover an interrupted turn, while random center rubbing cannot complete it.
observations.proposed_repair: No code repair indicated; assess whether the orbit remains visually and physically followable on the phone.
observations.acceptance_test: A child completes a twirl in either direction with ordinary finger movement, can lift and continue, and does not mistake center rubbing for progress.

observations.title: Assistance waits for the child's turn and never auto-completes
evidence: scripts/opera_ballet_surface.gd:258-274 excludes demo time from the assist clock and starts demonstrations at 5 and 10 seconds without progress.
scripts/probe_opera_gesture_quality.gd:212-226 checks both thresholds and confirms neither awards pose progress.
observations.reproduction: Finish the first pose demo, advance playable time to 4.9 seconds and then 5.1; after the assist demo, advance to the 10-second threshold and confirm pose_round stays unchanged.
observations.child_impact: Help can re-show or enlarge a cue without taking the accomplishment away from the child.
observations.proposed_repair: No repair indicated by the probe; observe whether the re-demonstration is understood as help rather than a repeated instruction.
observations.acceptance_test: With no input, assistance becomes more explicit at the documented active-play thresholds but the recital remains incomplete until the child performs the action.

observations.title: Visible route and device feel remain unobserved
evidence: scripts/probe_opera_gesture_quality.gd:185-194 creates BalletSurface directly at 854x660, bypassing Opera House navigation.
audit/cycles/luna-playtest-20261012/runtime/L23/attempt_1/receipt.json records headless=true, rendered_mobile_acceptance=false, and 4.7.2.stable; it reports 274 checks passing.
audit/findings/ACTIVE_FINDINGS_2026-08-13.md:397-417 (MA-PLAY-001), :489-509 (MA-TOUCH-001), and :720-740 (MA-CHILD-001) retain route, phone-input, and child-observation gaps.
observations.reproduction: Review the probe setup and receipt: the surface is directly instantiated, no mobile visual capture or physical-device input is present, and no child session is recorded.
observations.child_impact: The mechanics may work in the scripted geometry while entry, hit targets, visibility, touch latency, or comprehension fail in the actual room and phone context.
observations.proposed_repair: Collect a route-based Mobile capture and intended-device touch/child observations before claiming usability or appeal; repair only issues those observations establish.
observations.acceptance_test: A fresh-save, no-debug session reaches and exits Ballerina through its visible Opera route; target-phone video/input trace confirms target visibility, one-finger response, lifting/resume, and a child independently understands each act.

strengths.claim: The three mechanics use different input verbs and each has generous targets in the probe geometry.
evidence: scripts/opera_ballet_surface.gd:26-43 provides 116-pixel ribbon corridor, 128-pixel resume pearl, 116-pixel twirl ring and 112-pixel handle; pose portraits are at least 180 pixels per scripts/probe_opera_gesture_quality.gd:201-204.

strengths.claim: Wrong and passive actions do not award progress, and interrupted deliberate actions preserve earned progress.
evidence: scripts/probe_opera_gesture_quality.gd:205-239 verifies pose demo/no wrong payout and real matching payout; :284-314 tests chord rejection and ribbon resume; :327-377 tests invalid twirl and both directions.

play_sequence.beat: Enter through the normal Opera House route and choose the Ballerina activity from its visible room trigger; record where Roshan and the activity choice appear.
play_sequence.input: Tap the visible Ballerina trigger once; wait for the room transition and spoken cue to finish.
play_sequence.appeal_test: Does the child identify the activity from its picture/setting without reading or adult direction?

play_sequence.beat: Watch Pearl Mirror show a held pose and moving demonstration cue.
play_sequence.input: No touch for the 2.15-second pose demonstration and its voice handoff; then wait one second.
play_sequence.appeal_test: Does the child watch Roshan, then look toward a matching portrait?

play_sequence.beat: Choose each matching mirror portrait and watch the pose phrase change position.
play_sequence.input: Tap one portrait, lift fully, wait through the next 2.15-second demo, then tap the matching portrait; repeat for all three rounds.
play_sequence.appeal_test: Does changing portrait position sustain attention, and does the child visibly enjoy Roshan's pose changes?

play_sequence.beat: Trace the luminous Ribbon Trail from its pearl along the S current.
play_sequence.input: Wait 1.55 seconds for the demo, press the highlighted start pearl, drag along the curve in short strokes, lift near halfway, wait through the 1.55-second replay, then press the new pearl and continue.
play_sequence.appeal_test: Does the child treat the glowing trail as a path and choose to continue after lifting?

play_sequence.beat: Perform Grand Twirl around the shell music box.
play_sequence.input: Wait 1.55 seconds for the demo, press the pearl handle on the ring, drag around the ring in a comfortable direction, lift around halfway, wait through the replay, then press the moved handle and continue in the same direction.
play_sequence.appeal_test: Does the child imitate the demonstrated turn and notice Roshan's pose cue changes?

play_sequence.beat: Finish the recital and observe the return/replay choice.
play_sequence.input: Release after the final twirl sector; wait for completion response and one second before touching any visible exit/replay control.
play_sequence.appeal_test: Does the child request another act or recital on their own, or leave calmly without adult help?

acceptance_gaps: No visible Opera route or return was exercised by this session; MA-PLAY-001 and MA-OPERA-012 external/visual acceptance stay open.
No actual phone touch, Mobile-rendered frame, latency, focus-loss or frame-pacing evidence; MA-TOUCH-001 and MA-PERF-001 remain open.
No observed child session establishes comprehension, discoverability, enjoyment, comfort or independent replay; MA-CHILD-001 remains open.
Probe checks signal keys and an existing voice resource length, not recording approval, audibility, or exact spoken cue quality on device.
